summary: For Northwind as of Sprint 10, an honest score is about 2 on most dimensions: ownership (most items unowned), definitions (one certified model, many copies), lifecycle (pipelines in only {{s10_pipelines|int}} workspaces) and data quality (reconciliations only for the BI team's models), with monitoring at 2–3 thanks to on-call alerts for certified models. The two best-value next steps are an ownership drive with "no owner, no publish", and certifying the top KPIs on the shared model.
steps: Score the estate, not the showcase: the BI team's certified model would score 4 on lifecycle; the tenant scores 2.
Ownership first: it unlocks every other dimension (someone to certify, someone to fix, someone to retire).
Then definitions: certify the top KPIs so the easiest path is the governed path.
Leave optimisation-level ambitions for next year; maturity rises one level at a time.

review.junior: Scores everything 3 because some good practice exists somewhere.
review.senior: Scores with evidence and picks next steps by value and effort.
review.architect: Ties the next steps to measurable targets and owners, and repeats the assessment every six months to show progress.
